description: Last Arrow Manufacturing LLC, based in Orrville, Ohio, is a premier precision Sheet Metal fabrication shop and manufacturer. At Last Arrow Manufacturing, we are committed to delivering top-notch craftsmanship and exceeding customer expectations.
